definitions.explanation: Not giving up easily; continuing to try despite difficulties or opposition.

examples.japanese: {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: We secured the contract through persistent negotiation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。

notes:
FORMS:
{粘|ねば}り (stickiness) + {強|づよ}い (strong)

The image is of something sticky that won't let go.
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - not tenacious (negative)
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}くて - tenacious and... (te-form)
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}かった - was tenacious (past)
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く + verb - tenaciously (adverb)
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ - tenacity (noun)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く⟦{交渉|こうしょう}する→交渉する：17189_koushousuru⟧ - to negotiate persistently
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く⟦{説得|せっとく}する→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧ - to persuade persistently
- {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧ - persistent effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{我慢強|がまんづよ}い→我慢強い：07164_gamanzuyoi⟧ - patient, enduring (emphasizes bearing hardship)
- ⟦しつこい→しつこい：06498_shitsukoi⟧ - persistent (often negative)
- ⟦{諦|あきら}めない→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧ - not giving up
